name: io.github.zapzapapi/zapzap-mcp
title: ZapZap API (WhatsApp)
description: Managed WhatsApp API for AI agents: send messages, media, polls, manage instances, groups, webhooks.

environmentVariables.name: ZAPZAP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from the ZapZap dashboard (Settings > API). Sent as the x-api-key header.

environmentVariables.name: ZAPZAP_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: API secret from the ZapZap dashboard. Sent as the x-api-secret header.

environmentVariables.name: ZAPZAP_INSTANCE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional default instance id so tools do not need instance_id on every call.

environmentVariables.name: ZAPZAP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose only read-only tools (no sending).
